operations.text: A roadmap entry may now be an AREA - a module or theme whose goal is "no known open defect" - whose `Scope: in -` list collects the findings born during work, one indented line each with its date, its origin and a pointer, until the list is worth a plan. That list is the fourth roadmap write: it grows at a finding's birth, while Status and Plans still change at the three events only. An installation older than the roadmap ports its live candidates into it once (the old rows marked taken up / done / dropped) and reads the roadmap alone for open work from then on; docs/WORKFLOW.md § Out-of-scope findings names the area line as a destination. Your own ROADMAP.md is a seed and is not re-rendered by this update: the one-sentence header that describes the area entry is your project's hand edit, made when you choose to.
